Hi, I'm Christopher Orellana. I'm currently pursuing an M.S. in Data Analytics at Baruch College while working as a Platform/AI Engineer. My work involves cloud and data platforms, automation, and supporting scalable technical systems. I'm especially interested in machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and autonomous systems.

Some of my projects:

- NASA Turbofan RUL Prediction:\
Built a machine learning project using NASA turbofan engine data to predict the remaining useful life of aircraft engines.

- CyberThreatNLP:\
Built an end-to-end analytics pipeline that ingests unstructured cybersecurity news, transforms it into structured threat intelligence, and delivers downstream analytics outputs for monitoring and prioritization.

AI & Platform Engineering

I currently work as a plaform/AI Engineer with cloud-based data platforms, AI enabled automation, access management, and production systems.

AI and Autonomous Systems

I'm continuing to develop my skills in machine learning and computer vision with the long-term goal of working on perception systems for robotics and autonomous technology.
